regions.name: Packet Valley
regions.subject: Internet Technologies
regions.description: Follow one letter across a valley and see how the internet carries it: layers, wires, frames, addresses, routes, ports, web requests and security.
regions.bigFact: Almost all internet traffic between continents travels through cables lying on the seabed, not through satellites.

regions.name: Algo Archipelago
regions.subject: Algorithms and Complexity
regions.description: Island-hop through the ideas behind fast programs: how to organise data, count the cost of a method, and pick a smarter way to solve a problem.
regions.bigFact: Fold a sheet of paper in half 42 times and it would be thick enough to reach the Moon.
